fire: The old castle has become a popular tourist attraction in the region.
Every summer the small town fills up with tourist buses from the city.
She bought a cheap tourist map at the kiosk near the station.
The island's economy depends almost entirely on tourist spending.
Our guide warned us about the tourist traps near the main square.
During the festival the tourist office stays open until midnight.
He got a tourist visa that lets him stay for ninety days.
Locals complain that the tourist season gets longer every year.
